question: Why does the first logon stay on Loading your personal settings after the registry self-heal repairs corrupt hive bins?
allowedInputs: sdk/lib/cmlib/hivecell.c HvpCreateHiveFreeCellList steps by the cell size, so a zero size leaves the offset unchanged
sdk/lib/cmlib/hivecell.c HvpComputeFreeListIndex asserts the free cell size is at least 8
sdk/lib/cmlib/hivedata.h a free cell has a positive size, HBLOCK_SIZE is 0x1000, and HBIN is the bin header
sdk/lib/cmlib/hiveinit.c self-heal rewrites a corrupt bin header and copies the cell bytes that were already there
Reported: that logon then repaired hive bins and stayed on Loading your personal settings while the processor remained in the free-cell walk
